name: coding-agents
description: Coding Agents same-repo continuation and new-task intake for named requests or strong continuation intent on valid .coding-agents state. Primary route: start new user-visible work with fresh task_id/epoch/scope while preserving historical runner packets; continue unfinished work with its existing identity. Fallback: parent-side work when official subagents are unavailable; never launch codex exec or a custom process runner. Do not auto-route unrelated generic coding.

interface.shortDescription: Same-repo continuation and new-task intake; official Codex spawn only for workers.
interface.longDescription: Select Coding Agents when the user names it, audits or repairs its state/CLI, or expresses strong continuation intent for a repository with valid .coding-agents state, such as a next stage, new specification, or new purpose in the same repo. Existing completed state never locks the repository. New work starts with fresh task_id/epoch/scope, replaces current generated task documents, and preserves runner history. Mere state presence and unrelated generic coding do not trigger it. Actual workers are dispatched only through official Codex subagent spawn tools; the CLI never launches codex exec or a custom runner fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use Coding Agents for the next stage in this same repo with a fresh task_id, epoch, and scope.
Continue this valid .coding-agents repo for a new purpose; keep runner history and replace current task state.
Audit or repair this Coding Agents state or source CLI; use only official Codex subagents for workers.
